problems.title: DP or search?

parts.prompt: Minimum path sum, moves in 4 directions:

problems.solution: Right/down moves form a DAG, so DP works. Four directions form cycles, so use Dijkstra.

problems.title: Dungeon

parts.prompt: Why does a forward max-health DP fail?
options: It ignores the lowest point reached earlier on the path

hints: Backwards: need at the exit cell = max(1, 1 − 10) = 1.
problems.solution: Right path: 0 → −4 → 10 needs a start of 5 (dips to 1). Down path: 0 → −6 needs 7. Answer 5.

problems.title: Rolling row
problems.statement: Updating dp[j] = g[i][j] + min(dp[j], dp[j−1]) left to right in a single array.

options: the value for the cell above
the value for the cell to the left
the value for the cell to the left (already this row)

hints: Which cells has the loop already overwritten?
problems.solution: Left-to-right order makes dp[j−1] the current row and dp[j] the previous row, exactly the two neighbours needed. Square problems also need the diagonal: save it in a variable.

parts.prompt: States for a 50 × 50 grid (steps × rows × rows ≈ 99 · 50 · 50)?

problems.solution: Moving in lockstep, col = step − row, so the state is (step, r₁, r₂): about 2.5 × 10⁵ states with 4 transitions each.
